data.name: Escape the Backrooms Bodycam
data.detailed_description:
Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM drops you into a collapsing reality where nothing is stable, and nowhere is safe. Trapped deep within the shifting Backrooms, you must survive a nightmare of distorted spaces, lethal encounters, and psychological dread.

With only your gear, instincts, and limited supplies, you’ll navigate ever-changing environments, uncover hidden truths, and fight to stay alive as the world around you breaks apart.

📹 Hyper-Realistic Bodycam Horror
Experience intense immersion through a bodycam perspective featuring realistic motion, distortion effects, and oppressive sound design that makes every moment feel unpredictable and real.

🔫 Brutal Combat Encounters
Face deadly, aggressive entities and armed enemies. Every fight is high risk—manage ammo, choose your battles carefully, or avoid confrontation when possible.

🌀 The Endless Backrooms
Explore shifting corridors and surreal spaces that evolve as you progress. The deeper you go, the more unstable reality becomes.

🎥 Investigate and Record
Use your camcorder to capture anomalies, track changes in the environment, and uncover fragments of what really happened here.

🧩 Dynamic Objectives and Progression
Complete evolving missions, find weapons and tools, and unlock new layers of the Backrooms as you push closer to the truth.

💀 Survive at Any Cost
There is no comfort, no certainty, and no second chance. Adapt quickly or be consumed by the maze.

Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM delivers intense psychological horror, tactical survival, and relentless tension in a world where reality itself is broken.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 and better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 and better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 and better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3050 and better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
